about.title: About Hexa Terminal
about.subtitle: We build software systems that run real businesses.
about.heroTitle: We build software around how businesses actually operate.
about.heroSubtitle: HexaTerminal designs and develops ERP and CRM systems, web platforms, mobile applications, and business software with a focus on real workflows, reliable architecture, and long-term usability.
about.heroAsideTitle: HexaTerminal builds complete software systems, not isolated interface work.
about.heroAsideBody: We work from the operational problem through the architecture, product flow, backend logic, data structure, and integrations needed to make the system reliable in real use.
about.heroAsidePoint1: Operational understanding comes before screen design.
about.heroAsidePoint2: Product, backend, and data decisions are shaped together.
about.heroAsidePoint3: Delivery stays maintainable after launch, not just presentable on day one.
about.deliveryModelTitle: How we create business value through complete system delivery.
about.deliveryModelSubtitle: The work moves from operational diagnosis to architecture, product experience, connected backend logic, and maintainable delivery.

problem.title: Operational problem
problem.body: We start with the workflow breakdown, business friction, and decision points the software needs to improve.

architecture.title: System architecture
architecture.body: We define the structure around permissions, data movement, integrations, and long-term operational reliability.

experience.title: Product experience
experience.body: Interfaces are shaped as part of the system so users can move through the workflow clearly and with less friction.

backend.title: Backend, data, integrations
backend.body: The product layer is backed by the logic, data model, and service connections needed for real production use.

delivery.title: Maintainable delivery
delivery.body: The goal is software that can keep evolving without becoming fragile after launch.

about.positioningBody: We start by understanding the workflow, users, data, and operational problem before deciding how the software should be built. The goal is not to add more tools, but to create a system that makes the business easier to operate.
about.approachPoint1: We begin with the operation behind the request, not a preselected stack.
about.approachPoint2: We map users, handoffs, permissions, and data before deciding how the product should behave.
about.approachPoint3: We connect product experience to backend logic instead of treating them as separate projects.
about.approachPoint4: We favor software that can be extended and maintained after the first delivery milestone.
about.trustSubtitle: The work stays grounded in the operational problem and the people who need to use the system.

businessFirst.title: Business-first analysis
businessFirst.body: We begin with the workflow and the decisions it needs to support.

clearScope.title: Clear scope and communication
clearScope.body: We make the work, priorities, and next steps understandable throughout delivery.

pricing.title: Pricing & Engagement Models
pricing.subtitle: How we scope and price serious software engagements -- transparently, without a one-size-fits-all price tag.
pricing.philosophyBody: Custom software isn't a commodity, so we don't pretend it has a single sticker price. We scope each engagement around your real operational problem, then agree a fixed structure before any build work starts.
pricing.modelsSubtitle: Different problems call for different shapes of engagement. Most projects start with one of these.
pricing.costDriversBody: Scope, user and permission complexity, integrations, AI requirements, data migration, and delivery speed are the main factors. The estimator below reflects all of them.
pricing.paymentBody: Payment structure is agreed per engagement during scoping. We work in clear milestones so you always know what's being delivered and when.
pricing.ownershipBody: Ownership terms are confirmed in the engagement agreement. We're happy to discuss them upfront -- there are no surprises at handover.
pricing.supportBody: Post-launch support is offered as a separate, optional plan rather than bundled into the build, so you only pay for what you need.
pricing.estimatorCtaTitle: Get an indicative estimate in minutes
pricing.estimatorCtaBody: Answer a few questions about your project and see an indicative range immediately -- no email required.
pricing.noModels: Engagement models are being finalized. Get in touch and we'll scope your project directly.
pricing.guidanceNote: Prices are scoped per engagement. Use the estimator for an indicative range, then book a discovery call for a firm figure.

estimator.title: Cost Estimator
estimator.subtitle: Answer a few questions to see an indicative range and timeline. This is not a binding quotation -- it's a fast, honest starting point.
estimator.unavailable: The estimator isn't available right now. Please request a scoped estimate instead.
estimator.disclaimer: This is an indicative estimate, not a binding quotation. Final scope and price are confirmed during a discovery conversation. Third-party service costs are excluded, and taxes depend on your jurisdiction.
estimator.nextStepsTitle: What would you like to do next?
